profile.lead: A cybersecurity and cloud computing student focused on offensive security and web development.
profile.body: After a DUT in Computer Science, I am pursuing a Bachelor's degree at ESTK (Cadi Ayyad University). At GEBRAIN, I designed ASTA, an autonomous Python penetration testing agent, and built Student Hub with Django and React. I am looking for a cybersecurity internship where I can apply vulnerability analysis and web application security skills.

studies.current: Bachelor's in Cybersecurity & Cloud Computing · ESTK, Cadi Ayyad University
studies.previous: DUT in Computer Science · EST Fkih Ben Salah

points: Designed and developed ASTA (Autonomous Security Testing Agent), an LLM-guided penetration testing agent in Python on Kali Linux.
Used and integrated security tools (Nmap, Nuclei, Feroxbuster, SQLmap, Hydra, Dalfox, Nikto) for penetration testing.
Validated on authorized targets (a home router and an intentionally vulnerable demo web application): identified critical CVEs, up to CVSS 9.8; produced structured reports (CVE, CVSS, remediation).
Designed and developed Dakoro, a full-stack inventory and sales dashboard (real-time KPIs and interactive charts).
Built a Node.js/Express REST API connected to a React.js front end and designed the database schema (products, transactions, reporting).
Participated in the daily IT operations of a major Moroccan banking institution.
Observed database and systems management practices in a regulated financial environment.

projects.academic: Academic project · built in a pair

asta.subtitle: Autonomous Security Testing Agent
asta.summary: A security testing tool that coordinates specialized agents and turns their observations into structured reports. Used only within an authorized scope and with operator approval.
asta.policy: Every offensive action requires an authorized scope and operator approval.
points: Five-phase, multi-agent pipeline guided by LLMs (Groq, Cerebras, Gemini) through an OODA loop.
Policy Engine, local CVE database, real-time monitor and automatic report generation.

student.summary: A multi-role platform for students, teachers and administrators, with courses, assignments, announcements and real-time notifications.
points: Secure REST API (JWT, Google OAuth 2.0), role-based access control and deployment on Vercel (Neon, Cloudinary).
Complete UML documentation and project delivery using the SCRUM method.

skills.lead: Strong foundations built through practice and teamwork.
